# Separate SVG source simplification from visual equivalence

Entry 726 removes the white background rectangle, blanket fill none, explicit black fill and evenodd rules from TB-symbolic.svg. The remaining path data is byte-equal before and after, and accepted SVG retains the single path in a 32 by 32 viewBox. The XML comparison is source evidence only: changed fill rules and a removed rectangle can affect rendering. Preserve a rendering check when claiming this cleanup has no visual effect.

Scope: mail/branding/thunderbird.
